intro: Be part of the experience. Let our camera crew capture the people, places, and details around it — with photography, video, or both, coordinated with your Miami plans.
caption: REAL PEOPLE. MIAMI MOMENTS.
galleryBody: A selection of existing shoot photographs, from time on the water to nights in the city. Drag or swipe to explore the gallery.

steps.title: Choose your format.
steps.body: Photography, video, or both. Tell us the occasion and what you’d like to take away from the shoot.

steps.title: Shape the brief.
steps.body: Agree on the location, coverage, edited deliverables, quote, and delivery timeline before the day.

steps.title: Keep the day connected.
steps.body: Your crew and concierge coordinate timing and access around your confirmed plans.

ctaEyebrow: MAKE IT PART OF YOUR STAY
ctaBody: Share your dates, plans, and whether you’re looking for photos, video, or both. We’ll help coordinate a shoot around your experience.
heroAlt: Portrait inside a turquoise-lit luxury van
insetAlt: Lifestyle portrait on a jet ski in Miami
